name: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers and Chemicals Limited

facts.business: Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited (GNFC) is a diversified company engaged in the manufacturing and sale of fertilizers (Urea, Nitro Phosphate), industrial chemicals (TDI, Formic Acid, Acetic Acid, Nitric Acid, etc.), and information technology services.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital work in progress as at March 31, 2026

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding demand of ₹ 21,370 crores by Department of Telecommunications (DoT) towards VSAT and ISP Licenses fee relating to earlier years; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Volatility in energy and commodity markets
Natural gas supply constraints affecting plant operations
Regulatory risk: Demand of ₹ 21,370 crores by DoT for VSAT/ISP license fees
Revision in energy and fixed cost norms pursued with Government
Dependence on government subsidy policies for Urea
facts.related_party_note: Not explicitly detailed in excerpts; transactions with Gujarat State Investments Ltd. and Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Ltd. (promoters) implied via shareholding.
